prompt_md: Northbound trains leave at :00, :10, :20…; southbound ones at :01, :11, :21… You show up at a random moment and take the first train. Chance you go north?
prompt_short: North at :00, :10…; south at :01, :11… Random arrival. Chance you go north?
hint_md: Which train ends the longer gap?
explain_intuition_md: Each 10-minute cycle has a 9-minute gap that ends with a northbound train and a 1-minute gap that ends with a southbound one. Arrive at a random moment and you are 9 times as likely to land in the long gap. Both trains run equally often, which is why 50% feels right.
